proposal.summary: Diasoft File Replication Pro 7.5.0 allows privilege escalation by replacing a legitimate file with a trojan that will be executed as LocalSystem because the installation directory (%ProgramFiles%\FileReplicationPro) grants Everyone full control.

C.quote: allows attackers to escalate privileges by replacing a legitimate file with a Trojan horse that will be executed as LocalSystem.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify and document which executable(s) in %ProgramFiles%\FileReplicationPro are writable by Everyone, reproduce exploitation to identify the exact attack path, and restrict directory permissions to administrators and the service account; prepare a vendor advisory and patch guidance.
